minors.issue: TestEnrollRejectsResponseKeyOtherThanTLSKey asserts only that Enroll returned some error, not that the error comes from the leaf-key/response-key comparison.
minors.scenario: If a later change makes this hand-built server fail for an unrelated reason (for example the envelope encoding or a TLS setting), the test still passes even when the key-equality check in internal/agent/enroll.go:144-146 has been removed.

minors.issue: checkURL validates only the initial MOONGLASS_URL. http.DefaultClient still follows redirects, and Go copies the Authorization header to a same-host redirect target whatever its scheme.
minors.scenario: A misconfigured TLS front at https://cp.example answers 302 to http://cp.example/v1/servers. The generated runner follows the redirect and sends the owner bearer in clear, even though the spec says an http:// non-loopback URL sends nothing. A hostile network cannot cause this, because the first hop is CA-verified, so it is harmless to this ticket's threat model.
